title: Crest One | KEY.co
description_expanded: This stunning 30A coastal retreat offers the ultimate in luxury and comfort, perfectly designed for unforgettable multi-generational family vacations. Boasting five spacious bedrooms across three levels, the home features a rooftop terrace with sweeping 180-degree Gulf views—ideal for sunset dining al fresco. Whether you’re enjoying a lively game of foosball or ping pong on the first floor, lounging by the expansive heated community pool with private cabanas, or strolling mere steps to the sugar-white sands, every moment is crafted for relaxation and joy. A six-seater golf cart and two bikes make exploring Blue Mountain Beach a breeze, whether it’s savoring Sunday brunch at Blue Mabel, grabbing pastries from Blue Mountain Bakery, or shopping and dining at Gulf Place. The home’s upscale amenities ensure a seamless and comfortable stay. A fully stocked kitchen, full linen package, and a convenient starter kit of essentials complement luxury touches like a private rooftop deck with a grill, an elevator, and a cozy first-level patio with a firepit. Located in the heart of 30A, this retreat is surrounded by the Emerald Coast’s pristine beaches, charming coastal towns, and vibrant attractions, from Grayton Beach State Park to boutique shopping and dining at Seaside. Whether unwinding poolside or exploring the tranquility of Blue Mountain Beach, this home promises a vacation defined by indulgence, connection, and breathtaking beauty.
